EMPLOYMENT AGREEMENT

This Employment Agreement (the "Agreement") is entered into as of June 1, 2022, by and between Accme Healthcare Solutions, Inc., a Texas corporation ("Company"), and Dr. Sarah J. Whitfield ("Employee").

1. EMPLOYMENT. Company employs Employee as Senior Clinical Research Director. Employee's primary place of business shall be Company's Austin, Texas office.

2. COMPENSATION. Company shall pay Employee an annual base salary of $185,000.00, payable in accordance with Company's standard payroll practices. Employee shall be eligible for an annual performance bonus of up to 20% of base salary.

3. BENEFITS. Employee shall be entitled to participate in Company's standard benefits programs, including health insurance, retirement plans, and paid time off.

4. CONFIDENTIALITY. Employee acknowledges that during employment, Employee will have access to confidential and proprietary information. Employee agrees to maintain the confidentiality of such information during and after employment.

5. NON-SOLICITATION. During employment and for a period of 24 months following termination, Employee shall not directly or indirectly solicit any employee, contractor, or client of Company.

6. NON-COMPETE COVENANT. 
6.1 During employment and for a period of 24 months following termination (the "Restricted Period"), Employee shall not, directly or indirectly, engage in, own, manage, operate, control, or participate in any business that competes with Company's business within a 50-mile radius of Company's principal office in Austin, Texas (the "Restricted Territory").
6.2 The parties acknowledge that Company's business includes clinical research, pharmaceutical trial management, and healthcare data analytics.
6.3 Employee acknowledges that the restrictions contained herein are reasonable and necessary to protect Company's legitimate business interests, including its confidential information and customer relationships.

7. TERMINATION. This Agreement may be terminated by either party upon 30 days' written notice. Company may terminate Employee for cause immediately upon written notice.

8. GOVERNING LAW. This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of the State of Texas. Any dispute arising under this Agreement shall be resolved exclusively in the state courts located in Travis County, Texas.

9. ENTIRE AGREEMENT. This Agreement constitutes the entire agreement between the parties and supersedes all prior agreements and understandings.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties have executed this Agreement as of the date first written above.

ACME HEALTHCARE SOLUTIONS, INC.

By: ___________________________
Name: Robert T. Nakamura
Title: Chief Executive Officer

EMPLOYEE

___________________________
Dr. Sarah J. Whitfield
